name: Echoes of the Hollow
detailed_description:
This is a work-in-progress build. The current version includes a partial level and basic exploration mechanics. More content and polish are in active development.

DESCEND INTO DARKNESS. UNEARTH THE FORGOTTEN. SURVIVE THE LIGHT.

Beneath the surface lies a world lost to time — a labyrinth of ancient ruins, cryptic machines, and creatures that thrive in the absence of light. In [Game Title], you are the last flicker of hope in a realm where illumination is both a weapon and a lure.

EXPLORE A LOST UNDERGROUND CIVILIZATION

Venture through a sprawling, interconnected world filled with crumbling architecture, bioluminescent fungi, and strange relics of a forgotten age. Every tunnel and chamber tells a story — if you can survive long enough to uncover it.

SOLVE PUZZLES FROM THE PAST

Unlock sealed doors, activate arcane mechanisms, and decipher forgotten glyphs. The remnants of the past hide keys to your survival — but not all secrets wish to be uncovered.

FEAR THE LIGHT

Your only ally is a fragile source of light… and even that may betray you. Some horrors awaken when seen. Others follow when you flee. Balance exploration with caution, and choose when to shine — or hide in the shadows.

FEATURES

  • A haunting atmospheric journey through subterranean biomes

  • Environmental storytelling with zero handholding

  • Light-based mechanics that affect puzzles and enemy behavior

  • Non-linear exploration with secrets hidden behind danger

  • A soundtrack that shifts with your sanity
